These are short, checked answers to the 30 questions guests ask us most on WhatsApp, grouped by topic. The essentials: you pay in THB, online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thailand time, day trips are fully refundable 48 hours or more before departure, and Ang Thong Marine Park is closed from 1 November to 15 December 2026, while Pig Island trips run every day of the year, weather permitting. Facts that change, such as visa rules and park fees, were last checked on 1 November 2026, and each topic links to the full guide.

Booking and payment

Every shared trip can be booked and paid online on its trip page; private boats and groups of 10 or more are booked by quote on WhatsApp. The rules that matter most:

RuleWhat it means
CurrencyCharged in THB; EUR/USD shown for reference only
PaymentCard, Apple Pay or Google Pay through a secure Stripe checkout
ConfirmationBy email or WhatsApp after payment; pickup time the evening before
Booking for tomorrowOnline until midnight Thailand time (ICT, UTC+7)
Booking for todayNot online; message us on WhatsApp
AgesAdult 12+ · Child 3–11 · Infant 0–2 free

The full rules are in our terms and conditions. For a private boat, see private speedboats from Koh Samui.

Cancellation and weather

One policy covers every trip. If we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date.

TripFull refund50% refundNo refund
Day tours (Pig Island, Koh Tao, party boats)48 h+ before24–48 h beforeUnder 24 h or no-show
Ang Thong tours (day and overnight)48 h+ beforeNoneUnder 48 h or no-show

The north-east monsoon makes October to December the roughest months, with November the wettest at around 445 mm of rain. Read Koh Samui weather by month, live sea conditions and our guide to Koh Samui in November before booking in the monsoon.

Hotel pickup

Hotel pickup is included from most areas of Koh Samui. Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut (and other remote areas) add 400 THB per person, return. The surcharge areas depend on the departure pier, so the booking form shows the exact charge for your hotel. Pickup times arrive the evening before; for Ang Thong speedboat tours they usually fall between 07:30 and 08:30. Pig Island trips leave from Thong Krut on the south-west coast, and the island's roads are explained in getting around Koh Samui.

Travel to Koh Samui

TopicKey fact (checked 1 Nov 2026)
Flight from BangkokAbout 1 h 05 min; roughly 2,800–6,800 THB one way
Overland from BangkokNight train, bus and ferry: about 15–17 h door to door
Visa-free stay30 days for UK, US, EU, Australian and many other passports, since 15 Sep 2026
Arrival cardTDAC, free, online within 3 days before arrival
Tourist entry feeProposed, not collected
Airport taxi to ChawengAbout 400–600 THB

File the arrival card only on the official TDAC portal; look-alike sites charge fees. Full details are in how to get to Koh Samui, our Thailand visa guide and the Samui Airport guide.

Safety and health

ServiceNumber
Ambulance1669
Police191
Tourist Police (English)1155
Fire199

The main risks on Samui are the roads and the sea: rip currents and red flags on Chaweng and Lamai from October to December, box jellyfish (pour vinegar on a sting for at least 30 seconds), and scooter accidents. Riding without a helmet can cost a fine of up to 2,000 THB, and vapes are illegal in Thailand. Read our safety guide, beach safety, hospitals and travel insurance guides. Boat access for limited mobility is covered on our accessibility page.
